name: BUSTab Strip

props.name: selected
props.description: Index of the currently selected tab.

props.description: Callback when a tab is selected: (index: number) => void.

props.description: Array of tab objects: { title: string|element, count: string, countPosition: 'front'|'back', titleLabelText: string, titleLabelType: LabelTypeEnum, titleClassName: string, showDot: bool, renderComponent: element, tabCallback: function }.

props.name: keepTabsMounted
